title: lithocarpus longicaudatus
intro: Lithocarpus longicaudatus, commonly known as the California nutmeg or California canyon live oak, is a species of plant in the beech family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus longicaudatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents of this plant.
